function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"-- Get August margin per unit per channel
WITH aug_margin AS (
  SELECT c.channel,
         (SUM(s.revenue_cad) - SUM(s.cost_cad)) / NULLIF(SUM(s.qty),0) AS margin_per_unit_cad
  FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.sales_line s
  JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.customer c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl ON s.sku = pl.sku AND s.period = pl.period
  WHERE s.period = '2026-08'
  GROUP BY c.channel
),
-- Get September quantities per channel
sep_qty AS (
  SELECT c.channel, SUM(s.qty) AS qty
  FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.sales_line s
  JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.customer c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE s.period = '2026-09'
  GROUP BY c.channel
),
-- Get August quantities per channel for shares
aug_qty AS (
  SELECT c.channel, SUM(s.qty) AS qty
  FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.sales_line s
  JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.customer c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE s.period = '2026-08'
  GROUP BY c.channel
),
-- Compute totals
aug_total AS (SELECT SUM(qty) AS total_qty FROM aug_qty),
sep_total AS (SELECT SUM(qty) AS total_qty FROM sep_qty),
-- Compute weighted average margin for August using Aug unit margins and Aug shares
aug_weighted_margin AS (
  SELECT SUM(a.margin_per_unit_cad * (aq.qty / at.total_qty)) AS weighted_margin
  FROM aug_margin a
  JOIN aug_qty aq ON a.channel = aq.channel
  CROSS JOIN aug_total at
),
-- Compute weighted average margin for September mix using Aug unit margins and Sep shares
sep_weighted_margin AS (
  SELECT SUM(a.margin_per_unit_cad * (sq.qty / st.total_qty)) AS weighted_margin
  FROM aug_margin a
  JOIN sep_qty sq ON a.channel = sq.channel
  CROSS JOIN sep_total st
)
SELECT 
  aug_weighted_margin.weighted_margin AS aug_weighted_margin_cad_per_unit,
  sep_weighted_margin.weighted_margin AS sep_weighted_margin_cad_per_unit,
  st.total_qty AS sep_total_qty,
  (sep_weighted_margin.weighted_margin - aug_weighted_margin.weighted_margin) * st.total_qty AS mix_effect_cad
FROM aug_weighted_margin, sep_weighted_margin, sep_total st;","purpose":"Compute mix effect: change in margin due to shift in channel mix at September total quantity, holding August unit margins constant"}
